transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because lately I just can’t keep my head clear at work. I lose track of what clients are saying, and I’ll reread the same chart note over and over and still not really take it in. Then I get stuck on simple decisions I used to handle without thinking.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I’m not really sure how to describe it. I guess I’ve felt off, but I don’t know if I’d call it sad exactly.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I don’t think so, not in a clear way. I mean, I get tense sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed anxiety as the main thing.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about it as hopelessness. I guess I just feel kind of stuck, but I don’t know if that’s about the future exactly.
Do you feel like you've been having a lower mood than usual?
I’m not really sure. Maybe a little lower than usual, but it’s hard for me to pin down. I just know I haven’t felt like myself.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do?

Yeah… not really. My guitar’s just been sitting in the corner, and I keep backing out of soccer and volunteering at the shelter. Even stuff I usually like, like cooking or going hiking, just feels like I’m going through the motions. It doesn’t feel like there’s much point to it.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you're doing, even if you're not motivated to do them?

Not really. Even if I make myself do something, like cooking or going for a hike, it just feels kind of empty. Like I’m doing the steps, but I’m not really enjoying it or seeing the point. And stuff like guitar or soccer… I mostly just avoid it now.
How long have you been feeling this way?

About a month, I think. It started around when the clinic lost some staff and my schedule got pushed into more late-evening coverage, plus a lot more crisis paperwork. Since then it’s just kind of stayed this way.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Honestly, not much. My guitar’s still just sitting there, and I keep bailing on soccer and volunteering. I’ve tried to cook or go hiking, but it just feels like I’m doing it because I’m supposed to, not because I’m actually enjoying it. It all feels kind of pointless.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

Yeah, I think so. My pants have been feeling looser lately. I’m not really trying to lose weight or anything—I just don’t feel hungry most days unless someone reminds me to eat, so I end up skipping meals without meaning to.
Do you feel like you've been feeling sad most of the day?
I’m not really sure I’d call it sad all day. It’s more like I feel low or kind of empty most of the time, but I haven’t been tracking exactly how much of the day it is.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to play guitar and actually look forward to soccer and helping at the shelter, but lately I just keep avoiding all of it. Even when I try to do stuff like cooking or going for a hike, it just feels like I’m going through the motions. It doesn’t really feel enjoyable anymore.
Would you say that your low mood or empty feeling is mild, or is it interfering with your daily life in a more significant way?

It’s more than mild. It’s gotten to the point where it’s affecting my work. I actually told my supervisor I needed help because I was making mistakes and hesitating with clients, and I didn’t trust myself to keep working safely without being evaluated.
Would you say that most days, you've been feeling either sad, empty, or both?
I think… yeah, most days I’d say it’s there in some form. More empty than outright sad, usually, but it’s been pretty consistent.
Would you describe your current feelings of emptiness or low mood as being most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not totally sure how to measure it. It’s there a lot of the time, most days, but I don’t know if I’d say it’s clearly most of the day every single day.
Would you say your low mood or empty feeling is present for most of the day?
I’m not completely sure. It’s there for a lot of the day on many days, but I don’t know that I can honestly say it’s most of the day every day.
For how many days in a row have you been feeling this low mood or empty feeling?
About a month, I think. It started after the clinic lost some staff and my schedule shifted into late-evening coverage with a lot more crisis paperwork. Since then it’s been pretty steady.
Has your low mood or empty feeling been present for at least two weeks?
Yes. It’s been about a month now, since the clinic lost staff and my schedule moved into more late-evening coverage with heavier crisis paperwork.
Has your low mood or empty feeling been present for more than two weeks but less than two months?
Yes. It’s been around a month, so more than two weeks but not two months. It started when the clinic lost staff and my schedule moved into late evenings with more crisis paperwork.
Would you say your low mood or empty feeling has been present for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past month?
Yes… I’d say it’s been there most days, most of the day. It’s been going on about a month now, since the clinic lost staff and my schedule shifted to late-evening coverage with more crisis paperwork.
